_readme: Operator-maintained media inventory for content PinFlix has the right to distribute. Only list real verified HLS .m3u8 or MP4 .mp4 URLs; never infer movie paths from TMDB metadata or use demo videos as unrelated films. Configure MEDIA_SOURCE_ALLOWED_HOSTS for all entries and MEDIA_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS for any HTTP origins.
_example_movie_123: Add an entry with the key movie:<tmdbId> and an array of {label, url}, after confirming distribution permission and media availability.
_example_tv_456_s1e2: Use the key tv:<tmdbId>:s<season>e<episode> for a specific licensed TV episode. Do not place demo video links under commercial title IDs.
